# Third-party code

Code in this folder was not written for OpenHogs. It keeps its original
license; see also the Credits section of the main README.

| Folder | What | License |
|--------|------|---------|
| `glad/` | OpenGL 3.3 core loader generated by [glad 2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) | WTFPL or CC0-1.0; `khrplatform.h` Apache-2.0 (Khronos) |

Libraries downloaded at configure time (SDL3, GLM, Catch2) are listed in
`cmake/OpenHogsDependencies.cmake` and `tests/CMakeLists.txt`.
